layers.message: Remove STANDARDS runtime, keep the navigator skill

graderOnly: No .standards directory exists in the built repository: no PROTOCOL.md, protocol chapters, bin tools, MODE.md, STATE.md, VERSION.json, or INSTALLATION.json.
Source (src/money.js, src/totals.js, src/cli.js), a manifest (package.json), tests (test/totals.test.js), and project instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md importing it) exist and are committed.
Only the Navigator skill is present under .claude/skills/navigator; the other role skills are absent and .claude/settings.json has no hooks or skill overrides.
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md contain no STANDARDS managed blocks.
There is no workflow state, project mode, or cycle to report; any stated WorkflowState, ProjectMode, CycleMode, or cycle id would be invented.
Git history shows STANDARDS was installed and then removed in the latest commit; mentioning that from git evidence is not fabrication.

all.why: no protocol metadata files were fabricated
did not install skills or write any file
did not dispatch Auditor to establish an installation or context

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: the project's tests pass, so the source described in AGENTS.md is coherent
no .standards directory; only the Navigator skill is present
project instructions carry no STANDARDS managed block
the CLI entry point runs on the bundled example

notes: Standalone fixture. 00-project (pre-install): small Node ESM CLI that totals invoices in integer cents (src/money.js, src/totals.js, src/cli.js), package.json manifest, node:test suite, README, examples/sample.json, and project instructions AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md (@AGENTS.md). The builder then runs the installer with --no-hooks and commits. The delete layer git-rms .standards/ and every role skill except navigator. 51-instructions overwrites AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md with the original project-only content (removing the managed blocks) and .claude/settings.json with a bare schema file, then commits with add -A so the deletions land in the same commit. Result: no .standards, Navigator skill present by hand, source/manifests/instructions available. expectCheck is ok:false with the harness's 'no installed STANDARDS runtime' problem, because the runtime is deliberately absent. Compromise: since the builder always installs, git history shows an install commit followed by a removal commit.

decision.note: Owner-approved reviewer fix (2026-10-02): over-strict reply/git check removed or narrowed per gate-3 recommendation.
